# Mirrors documentation has moved

> The current Mirrors documentation is at https://mirrors.dev/docs

Mirrors helps developers maintain production AI agents. It surfaces recurring mistakes across an agent's runs and turns them into targeted corrections that you preview and apply only in the situations where they belong.

This site used to document an earlier Mirrors product that built digital twins of an agent's backends and replayed sessions against them. That product is no longer offered. For anything current, use the links below.

- [Mirrors](https://mirrors.dev/): Product overview.
- [Documentation](https://mirrors.dev/docs): Current documentation.
- [Product summary for agents](https://mirrors.dev/llms.txt): Definition, FAQ and guides.
- [Documentation index for agents](https://mirrors.dev/docs/llms.txt): Links to individual Markdown pages.
